description: This file defines a utility class 'XmlUtils' with static methods for parsing XML documents using XmlPullParser, including starting document parsing and moving to the next element.

classes.name: XmlUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for XML parsing operations.

methods.name: beginDocument
methods.description: Initializes parsing by advancing the parser to the first start tag and verifies it matches the expected element name.

methods.name: nextElement
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next start tag and returns whether there are more elements to process.
